proof:
Source: parent Part IV (Simon 6.2–6.3). Uses (SL) = sibling slicing and (REP), (MM), (IML) of sibling foundations; (DTr) only for m := d (degree d + 1 < P), CL_P(d) only in U := ℝ^P.
1. Let (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep of R and μ := θH^{d+1}⌞M (|ξ| ≤ 1 a.e. by (IMC)(d)); (REP) gives (μ', ξ') for ∂R.
2. Fix x₀ ∈ U, r₀ > 0 with B̄_{2r₀}(x₀) ⊆ U, f := |· − x₀|, G := B_{r₀}(x₀). (SL) gives A_t = R⌞{f<t}, B_t = (∂R)⌞{f<t} and Z_t := ∂A_t − B_t vanishing off {f = t} with M_G(Z_t) ≤ liminf_h h⁻¹μ(G ∩ {t−h<f<t}); (MM) (constant sequence) gives r ∈ (0, r₀) with M_G(Z_r) < ∞, and a cut-off equal to 1 near the sphere {f = r} shows M(Z_r) ≤ M_G(Z_r).
3. R' := A_r is IM by (IMC)(b) (carrier M ∩ B_r(x₀)), spt R' ⊆ B̄_r(x₀), M(R') ≤ μ(B_r(x₀)) and M(∂R') ≤ μ'(B_r(x₀)) + M(Z_r) < ∞.
4. Take ζ ∈ C_c^∞(U; [0, 1]) with ζ = 1 near B̄_r(x₀) and put R̂'(ω) := R'(ζω) for ω ∈ 𝒟^{d+1}(ℝ^P): an IM current in ℝ^P (same IMRep), spt R̂' ⊆ B̄_r(x₀) compact, M(R̂') = M(R'), and ∂R̂'(η) = ∂R'(ζη) by (VO), so M(∂R̂') ≤ M(∂R') < ∞.
5. (DTr) for (P, m := d) with ρ_k := 2^{−k} gives Q_k, ∂Q_k, R_k IM with R̂' − Q_k − S_k = ∂R_k, M(∂Q_k) ≤ cM(∂R̂'), M(R_k) ≤ cρ_kM(R̂'), M(S_k) ≤ cρ_kM(∂R̂'). Hence |R̂'(ω) − Q_k(ω)| ≤ M(S_k)‖ω‖_∞ + M(R_k)‖dω‖_∞ → 0, so Q_k ⇀ R̂' and ∂Q_k ⇀ ∂R̂'.
6. CL_P(d) with U := ℝ^P applied to the IM currents ∂Q_k (M_W(∂Q_k) ≤ cM(∂R̂'); boundaryMassOn(∂Q_k, W) = 0 since ∂∂ = 0 or d = 0) shows that ∂R̂' is IM.
7. For η ∈ 𝒟^d(B_r(x₀)): ∂R̂'(η) = ∂R'(η) = B_r(η) + Z_r(η) = ∂R(η) + 0. So (∂R)|_{B_r(x₀)} = (∂R̂')|_{B_r(x₀)} is IM by (IML)(2); since x₀ is arbitrary and ∂R has locally finite mass, (IML)(1) shows that ∂R is IM. ∎
